finalists.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
finalists.why: Dense infiltrate of atypical CD4+ small to medium-sized lymphocytes in the upper dermis admixed with eosinophils and plasma cells and second biopsy showing epidermotropism.

finalists.label: lymphoma
finalists.why: Molecular analysis of the T-cell receptor gamma gene showed a weak clonal band in a polyclonal background and dense infiltrate of atypical CD4+ small to medium-sized lymphocytes.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a dense infiltrate of atypical CD4+ small to medium-sized lymphocytes in the upper dermis admixed with eosinophils and plasma cells, along with second biopsy findings, specifically supports Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma over the broader category of lymphoma.

registry.preferred_label: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoma
